review: Independent read-only verification of the bounded CLI Mainnet run
verdict: PASS for the bounded live payment and budget-rejection checks; not an external organization approval

artifacts.publication: The run exercised a source-built bundle. The separate fresh public-registry verification subsequently confirmed that published @ackrate/cli@0.2.1 contains the exact same executable bytes.

checksAppliedToEveryPayment: RPC requested hash equals returned hash and recomputed Mainnet envelope hash
successful transaction has the configured agent as source
one invocation of official registry execute_payment with exact mandate ID, amount 100000 and expected sequence 0/1/2
one unambiguous typed WR payment event bound to the same mandate, merchant, canonical USDC and consumed sequence
one matching canonical Circle USDC transfer event from the configured payer to merchant for 100000 stroops

additionalReadOnlyFourthPaymentCheck.qualification: Independent read-only simulation corroborates budget rejection; public history cannot itself prove the CLI attempted the fourth HTTP request.

limitations: This is independent trusted-provider verification through pinned public RPC and Horizon, not a cryptographic ledger-state attestation.
HTTP resource labels and delivery completion require the retained runner/consumer/fulfillment output in addition to these public-chain receipts.
Publication provenance is established by the linked separate public-package record; the on-chain receipts alone do not establish npm provenance.
Abrupt host failure can leave a locked run and an incomplete most-recent local receipt snapshot; no crash-safe exact-delivery guarantee is made.
Generic SDK/CLI expired-settlement classification still rejects decimal-string RPC history timestamps and remains locked rather than clearing.

No seeds, private keys, capabilities, private funding envelopes, or secret environment values were accessed. Public transaction envelopes were decoded read-only. No signing or transaction submission occurred; saved evidence contains only public receipts and metadata.
